name: @dsbissett/excel-webview2-mcp

tools.name: click
tools.description: Clicks on the provided element

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

dblClick.description: Set to true for double clicks. Default is false.

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

tools.name: close_page
tools.description: Closes the page by its index. The last open page cannot be closed.

pageId.description: The ID of the page to close. Call list_pages to list pages.

tools.name: connection_status
tools.description: Reports whether the server is currently attached to a browser and which CDP endpoint it is tracking.

probe.description: If true, re-runs the CDP /json/version probe for the tracked endpoint instead of returning cached probe state.

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Drag an element onto another element

from_uid.description: The uid of the element to drag

to_uid.description: The uid of the element to drop into

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

tools.name: emulate
tools.description: Throttles network and/or CPU on the selected page.

networkConditions.description: Throttle network. Omit to disable throttling.

cpuThrottlingRate.description: Represents the CPU slowdown factor. Omit or set the rate to 1 to disable throttling

tools.name: evaluate_script
tools.description:
Evaluate a JavaScript function inside the currently selected page. Returns the response as JSON,
so returned values have to be JSON-serializable.

items.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

args.description: An optional list of arguments to pass to the function.

tools.name: excel_active_range
tools.description: Returns the currently selected Excel range (address, dimensions, and values). Optionally includes formulas and number formats. Requires an Excel add-in target with Excel.run available.

includeFormulas.description: If true, also return the A1-style formulas for each cell.

includeNumberFormat.description: If true, also return the Excel number-format code per cell.

tools.name: excel_calculation_state
tools.description: Returns the workbook calculation mode (automatic/manual/etc.) and current calculation state (done/calculating/pending).

tools.name: excel_chart_image
tools.description: Returns a chart rendered as a PNG image, encoded as base64. Useful for visual verification.

width.description: Image width in pixels. Defaults to the chart’s natural size.

height.description: Image height in pixels. Defaults to the chart’s natural size.

tools.name: excel_chart_info
tools.description: Returns detailed information about a chart: type, title, series names, axis titles, and source data address.

tools.name: excel_context_info
tools.description: Returns Office.js and Excel host information for the selected page, including supported requirement sets when available.

tools.name: excel_custom_xml_parts
tools.description: Lists custom XML parts stored in the workbook: id and namespace URI.

tools.name: excel_detect_addin
tools.description: Inspects a working directory and reports whether it looks like an Excel add-in project (manifest location, manifest kind, package manager, and any existing remote-debugging script).

cwd.description: Directory to inspect. Defaults to the MCP server working directory.

tools.name: excel_find_in_range
tools.description: Finds all matches of a text string within a range. Returns the combined match address and cell count.

address.description: A1 reference such as 'Sheet1!A1:C10' or 'A1:C10'. If omitted, the active selection is used.

sheet.description: Worksheet name. Used when address omits the sheet prefix; ignored if address includes one.

completeMatch.description: If true, require a whole-cell match. Defaults to false.

matchCase.description: If true, the search is case-sensitive. Defaults to false.

tools.name: excel_launch_addin
tools.description: Launches Excel with the detected add-in and WebView2 remote debugging enabled. Idempotent per manifest path: re-calling returns the tracked launch instead of spawning a duplicate.

tools.name: excel_list_charts
tools.description: Lists all charts across worksheets: name, id, worksheet, type, title, position, and size.

sheet.description: Worksheet name. Omit to list charts on all worksheets.

tools.name: excel_list_comments
tools.description: Lists comments and replies on a worksheet: author, content, timestamp, and cell address.

sheet.description: Worksheet name. Omit to use the active worksheet.

tools.name: excel_list_conditional_formats
tools.description: Lists conditional-format rules on a range: id, type, priority, stopIfTrue. Omit address to use the active worksheet’s used range.

address.description: A1 reference such as 'Sheet1!A1:C10' or 'A1:C10'. If omitted, the active selection is used.

sheet.description: Worksheet name. Used when address omits the sheet prefix; ignored if address includes one.

tools.name: excel_list_data_validations
tools.description: Returns data-validation configuration on a range: type, rule, error alert, and prompt. Omit address to use the active selection.

address.description: A1 reference such as 'Sheet1!A1:C10' or 'A1:C10'. If omitted, the active selection is used.

sheet.description: Worksheet name. Used when address omits the sheet prefix; ignored if address includes one.

tools.name: excel_list_named_items
tools.description: Lists workbook-scoped named items (named ranges and formulas) with name, type, value, formula, visibility, and comment.

tools.name: excel_list_pivot_tables
tools.description: Lists all PivotTables in the workbook with name, worksheet, layout address, and enabled flags.

tools.name: excel_list_shapes
tools.description: Lists shapes (including images) on a worksheet: name, id, type, position, size, visibility.

sheet.description: Worksheet name. Omit to use the active worksheet.

tools.name: excel_list_tables
tools.description: Lists all tables (ListObjects) in the workbook with name, worksheet, address, header/total row flags, row count, and style.

tools.name: excel_list_worksheets
tools.description: Lists all worksheets in the workbook with name, id, position, visibility, and tab color.

tools.name: excel_pivot_table_info
tools.description: Returns the structure of a PivotTable: row, column, data, and filter hierarchies with their source field names.

tools.name: excel_pivot_table_values
tools.description: Returns the rendered values of a PivotTable layout range with truncation when it exceeds the cell cap.

tools.name: excel_range_formulas
tools.description: Returns formulas (A1 and R1C1) alongside resolved values for a range. Useful for verifying formula edits.

address.description: A1 reference such as 'Sheet1!A1:C10' or 'A1:C10'. If omitted, the active selection is used.

sheet.description: Worksheet name. Used when address omits the sheet prefix; ignored if address includes one.

tools.name: excel_range_properties
tools.description: Returns rich properties for a range: value types, hasSpill, row/column hidden flags, and selected format details (font, fill, alignment, borders). Use include flags to bound payload.

address.description: A1 reference such as 'Sheet1!A1:C10' or 'A1:C10'. If omitted, the active selection is used.

sheet.description: Worksheet name. Used when address omits the sheet prefix; ignored if address includes one.

includeFormat.description: If true, include font, fill, alignment, and border summary per cell.

includeStyle.description: If true, include the named style of each cell.

tools.name: excel_range_special_cells
tools.description: Finds cells within a range matching a category: 'constants', 'formulas', 'blanks', or 'visible'. Optionally filter by value type. Returns the resulting address and cell count.

address.description: A1 reference such as 'Sheet1!A1:C10' or 'A1:C10'. If omitted, the active selection is used.

sheet.description: Worksheet name. Used when address omits the sheet prefix; ignored if address includes one.

cellType.description: Category of special cells to locate.

valueType.description: For 'constants' or 'formulas', filter by value type. Defaults to 'all'.

tools.name: excel_read_range
tools.description: Reads a range by address (e.g. 'Sheet1!A1:C10' or 'A1:C10' with a sheet param). Omit address to read the active selection. Returns values and optionally formulas / number formats.

address.description: A1 reference such as 'Sheet1!A1:C10' or 'A1:C10'. If omitted, the active selection is used.

sheet.description: Worksheet name. Used when address omits the sheet prefix; ignored if address includes one.

includeFormulas.description: If true, also return the A1-style formulas for each cell.

includeNumberFormat.description: If true, also return the Excel number-format code per cell.

tools.name: excel_settings_get
tools.description: Reads add-in document settings from Office.context.document.settings. Returns all keys or a single key’s value.

key.description: If provided, return only this setting’s value. Otherwise, return all settings.

tools.name: excel_stop_addin
tools.description: Stops the most recent Excel add-in launched by excel_launch_addin (or a specific manifest). Runs office-addin-debugging stop and kills the process if it does not exit cleanly.

tools.name: excel_table_filters
tools.description: Returns the active filter criteria per column for a table. Columns without an active filter have null criteria.

tools.name: excel_table_info
tools.description: Returns detail for a single table: name, worksheet, address, row count, columns (name + filter criteria), header/total row flags, and style.

tools.name: excel_table_rows
tools.description: Returns the data-body values of a table with truncation when row*column count exceeds the cell cap.

includeHeaders.description: If true, include the header row names.

tools.name: excel_used_range
tools.description: Returns values (and optionally formulas / number formats) for a worksheet’s used range, with truncation when the range exceeds the cell cap.

sheet.description: Worksheet name. Omit to use the active worksheet.

valuesOnly.description: If true (default), only cells with values count toward the used range.

includeFormulas.description: If true, also return the A1-style formulas for each cell.

includeNumberFormat.description: If true, also return the Excel number-format code per cell.

tools.name: excel_workbook_info
tools.description: Returns workbook-level metadata: name, save state, calculation mode and state, and protection state.

tools.name: excel_worksheet_info
tools.description: Returns metadata for a single worksheet: used range address, visibility, protection, gridlines, tab color, and dimensions.

sheet.description: Worksheet name. Omit to use the active worksheet.

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Type text into an input, text area or select an option from a <select> element.

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

tools.name: fill_form
tools.description: Fill out multiple form elements at once

uid.description: The uid of the element to fill out

elements.description: Elements from snapshot to fill out.

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

tools.name: get_console_message
tools.description: Gets a console message by its ID. You can get all messages by calling list_console_messages.

msgid.description: The msgid of a console message on the page from the listed console messages

tools.name: get_network_request
tools.description: Gets a network request by an optional reqid, if omitted returns the currently selected request in the DevTools Network panel.

reqid.description: The reqid of the network request. If omitted returns the currently selected request in the DevTools Network panel.

requestFilePath.description: The absolute or relative path to save the request body to. If omitted, the body is returned inline.

responseFilePath.description: The absolute or relative path to save the response body to. If omitted, the body is returned inline.

tools.name: handle_dialog
tools.description: If a browser dialog was opened, use this command to handle it

action.description: Whether to dismiss or accept the dialog

promptText.description: Optional prompt text to enter into the dialog.

tools.name: hover
tools.description: Hover over the provided element

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

tools.name: lighthouse_audit
tools.description: Get Lighthouse score and reports for accessibility, SEO and best practices. This excludes performance. For performance audits, run performance_start_trace

outputDirPath.description: Directory for reports. If omitted, uses temporary files.

tools.name: list_console_messages
tools.description: List all console messages for the currently selected page since the last navigation.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of messages to return. When omitted, returns all messages.

pageIdx.description: Page number to return (0-based). When omitted, returns the first page.

types.description: Filter messages to only return messages of the specified resource types. When omitted or empty, returns all messages.

includePreservedMessages.description: Set to true to return the preserved messages over the last 3 navigations.

tools.name: list_network_requests
tools.description: List all requests for the currently selected page since the last navigation.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of requests to return. When omitted, returns all requests.

pageIdx.description: Page number to return (0-based). When omitted, returns the first page.

resourceTypes.description: Filter requests to only return requests of the specified resource types. When omitted or empty, returns all requests.

includePreservedRequests.description: Set to true to return the preserved requests over the last 3 navigations.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Get a list of pages  open in the browser.

tools.name: performance_analyze_insight
tools.description: Provides more detailed information on a specific Performance Insight of an insight set that was highlighted in the results of a trace recording.

insightSetId.description: The id for the specific insight set. Only use the ids given in the "Available insight sets" list.

insightName.description: The name of the Insight you want more information on. For example: "DocumentLatency" or "LCPBreakdown"

tools.name: performance_start_trace
tools.description: Start a performance trace on the selected webpage. Use to find frontend performance issues, Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), and improve page load speed.

reload.description: Determines if, once tracing has started, the current selected page should be automatically reloaded.

autoStop.description: Determines if the trace recording should be automatically stopped.

filePath.description: The absolute file path, or a file path relative to the current working directory, to save the raw trace data. For example, trace.json.gz (compressed) or trace.json (uncompressed).

tools.name: performance_stop_trace
tools.description: Stop the active performance trace recording on the selected webpage.

filePath.description: The absolute file path, or a file path relative to the current working directory, to save the raw trace data. For example, trace.json.gz (compressed) or trace.json (uncompressed).

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a key or key combination. Use this when other input methods like fill() cannot be used (e.g., keyboard shortcuts, navigation keys, or special key combinations).

key.description: A key or a combination (e.g., "Enter", "Control+A", "Control++", "Control+Shift+R"). Modifiers: Control, Shift, Alt, Meta

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

tools.name: select_page
tools.description: Select a page as a context for future tool calls.

pageId.description: The ID of the page to select. Call list_pages to get available pages.

bringToFront.description: Whether to focus the page and bring it to the top.

tools.name: take_memory_snapshot
tools.description: Capture a heap snapshot of the currently selected page. Use to analyze the memory distribution of JavaScript objects and debug memory leaks.

filePath.description: A path to a .heapsnapshot file to save the heapsnapshot to.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the page or element.

format.description: Type of format to save the screenshot as. Default is "png"

quality.description: Compression quality for JPEG and WebP formats (0-100). Higher values mean better quality but larger file sizes. Ignored for PNG format.

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot. If omitted, takes a page screenshot.

fullPage.description: If set to true takes a screenshot of the full page instead of the currently visible viewport. Incompatible with uid.

filePath.description: The absolute path, or a path relative to the current working directory, to save the screenshot to instead of attaching it to the response.

tools.name: take_snapshot
tools.description:
Take a text snapshot of the currently selected page based on the a11y tree. The snapshot lists page elements along with a unique
identifier (uid). Always use the latest snapshot. Prefer taking a snapshot over taking a screenshot. The snapshot indicates the element selected
in the DevTools Elements panel (if any).

verbose.description: Whether to include all possible information available in the full a11y tree. Default is false.

filePath.description: The absolute path, or a path relative to the current working directory, to save the snapshot to instead of attaching it to the response.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text using keyboard into a previously focused input

submitKey.description: Optional key to press after typing. E.g., "Enter", "Tab", "Escape"

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file through a provided element.

uid.description: The uid of the file input element or an element that will open file chooser on the page from the page content snapshot

filePath.description: The local path of the file to upload

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait for the specified text to appear on the selected page.

text.description: Non-empty list of texts. Resolves when any value appears on the page.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

stderr:
excel-webview2-mcp exposes content of the browser instance to the MCP clients allowing them to inspect,
debug, and modify any data in the browser or DevTools.
Avoid sharing sensitive or personal information that you do not want to share with MCP clients.
Performance tools may send trace URLs to the Google CrUX API to fetch real-user experience data. To disable, run with --no-performance-crux.

Google collects usage statistics to improve Excel WebView2 MCP. To opt-out, run with --no-usage-statistics.
For more details, visit: https://github.com/dsbissett/excel-webview2-mcp#usage-statistics
